summary: Simple calculator web application with basic arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide)
architectural_notes: Single-page HTML application with embedded CSS and JavaScript
Client-side JavaScript for all calculations (no backend required)
Mobile-responsive design with viewport meta tag

existing_features.title: Create a calculator UI with two number input fields labeled 'First Number' and 'Second Number'
Add four operation buttons: Add, Subtract, Multiply, and Divide
Implement calculation logic for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division operations
Display calculation results below the operation buttons with 'Result:' prefix
Validate input fields and display 'Please enter valid numbers' error message when inputs are invalid
Handle division by zero with 'Cannot divide by zero' error message
Apply a modern, minimalist design style with clean typography, ample spacing, and a cohesive color scheme that avoids blue and purple
Display a calculation history section that shows a list of all previous calculations performed in the current session
Update the calculation history automatically whenever a successful calculation is performed (add, subtract, multiply, or divide)
Add a clear history button that removes all entries from the calculation history
Style the calculation history section consistently with the existing modern, minimalist design using the warm coral/orange color scheme

new_feature_requests.summary: Create calculator with two number inputs and four operation buttons
Implement addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division operations
Add input validation and divide-by-zero error handling
Add calculation history feature to track previous results
